title: Introductory inversion · 句首倒装入门
pattern: Negative adverb + auxiliary + subject + verb  ·  Hardly had + subject + V3 + when…
summary: 否定副词或否定意义的词放在句首时，要把助动词提到主语前面，用来加强语气，多见于书面语。
explanation: **句首倒装**是为了强调：把否定或限制性的词（never、rarely、seldom、hardly、little、only、not only 等）放在句首，后面的助动词要提到主语之前。例如普通句 I have never seen such a sunset. 强调的是“我从没见过”，而 **Never have I seen** such a sunset. 语气更重，也更有文学或演讲的感觉。

**倒装的基本规则**：句首否定词 + 助动词 / be 动词 + 主语 + 动词。如果原句没有助动词，就要借助 do、does 或 did：Rarely **does** he complain.（他很少抱怨。）原句 He rarely complains. 注意倒装后，主要动词恢复原形，不再加 -s 或 -ed。如果原句是 be 动词，就直接把 be 提前：Never **was** I so happy.

**hardly / scarcely / barely** 与 when 连用时，结构固定为 **Hardly had + 主语 + 过去分词 + when + 从句**：Hardly had we sat down **when** the phone rang.（我们刚坐下，电话就响了。）同样，**no sooner … than** 也要倒装：No sooner had she left **than** it started to rain.（她刚走，雨就下了起来。）
**not only … but also** 倒装时，只有前半句的助动词需要提前，后半句保持正常语序：Not only **did** she speak English, but she also speaks French.（她不仅会说英语，还会说法语。）如果前半句没有助动词，要借助 do 来倒装。
中文的否定词没有位置限制，学习者容易写成 Never I have seen 这样保留原语序的句子。学习倒装的关键是先识别句首的否定意义，再记住“助动词放到主语前”这个规则。日常口语里较少使用，但阅读和写作中非常常见。
mistakes: ✗ Never I have seen such a beautiful view. → ✓ Never have I seen such a beautiful view. 否定词放句首后，助动词 have 必须提到主语 I 之前。
✗ Hardly I had arrived when it started raining. → ✓ Hardly had I arrived when it started raining. hardly 后面的倒装是 had + 主语，不能保留陈述语序。
✗ Rarely she goes out at night. → ✓ Rarely does she go out at night. 原句没有助动词，要用 does 倒装，动词恢复原形 go。
✗ Not only he is clever, but also he is kind. → ✓ Not only is he clever, but he is also kind. 中文“不但……而且……”常直译成 not only he is，但英语只有前半句需要倒装，应写成 Not only is he…

examples.text: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
examples.translation: 我从未见过如此美丽的日落。

examples.text: Rarely does he complain about his work.
examples.translation: 他很少抱怨自己的工作。

examples.text: Hardly had we sat down when the waiter brought the menu.
examples.translation: 我们刚坐下，服务员就拿来了菜单。

examples.text: No sooner had she left the office than it started to rain.
examples.translation: 她刚离开办公室，雨就下了起来。

examples.text: Not only did the film win an award, but it also became a huge hit.
examples.translation: 这部电影不仅获奖，还大受欢迎。

examples.text: Only after the exam did I realise how much I had forgotten.
examples.translation: 考完试之后，我才意识到自己忘了多少。
examples.note: only + 时间状语放句首，也要倒装。

examples.text: Little did he know that the letter would change his life.
examples.translation: 他完全没想到，那封信会改变他的一生。

exercises.sentence: ___ felt so happy in my whole life.
exercises.translation: 我这辈子从未感到如此快乐。
options: Never I have
Never have I
I never have
Never I
exercises.explanation: 否定词 never 放句首，助动词 have 要提到主语 I 之前：Never have I。

options: he is
he was
does he be
is he
exercises.explanation: Rarely 放句首，be 动词 is 要提到主语 he 之前：Rarely is he late。

options: had I sat down
I had sat down
had sat I down
I sat down
exercises.explanation: hardly … when 的固定倒装结构是 Hardly had + 主语 + 过去分词。

exercises.source: 我从未听说过这样的事。
options: Never I have heard of such a thing.
Never have heard I of such a thing.
Never have I heard of such a thing.
Never did I have heard of such a thing.
exercises.explanation: Never 放句首后用 have + 主语 + 过去分词：Never have I heard。

exercises.source: 我们刚到家，电话就响了。
options: Hardly had we arrived home when the phone rang.
Hardly we had arrived home when the phone rang.
Hardly had we arrived home than the phone rang.
Hardly had we arrived home, the phone rang.
exercises.explanation: hardly 与 when 搭配，倒装成 Hardly had we arrived home when…；than 只用于 no sooner。

exercises.source: 她不仅会说英语，还会说法语。
options: Not only she speaks English, but she also speaks French.
Not only does she speak English, but she also speaks French.
Not only does she speaks English, but she also speaks French.
Not only does she speak English but also she speaks French.
exercises.explanation: 只需倒装前半句：Not only does she speak English，后半句保持正常语序。

options: Rarely does she complain about the noise.
Rarely she complains about the noise.
Seldom does he visit his grandparents.
exercises.explanation: Rarely 放句首时要用 does 倒装，应写成 Rarely does she complain。

options: No sooner had he left than the phone rang.
Only after the meeting did we understand the plan.
Not only he is clever, but also he is kind.
exercises.explanation: not only 放句首要倒装前半句，应写成 Not only is he clever, but he is also kind。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 我以前从未见过这么大的人群。
exercises.explanation: Never before 放句首，助动词 had 提到主语 I 之前，构成 had + 主语 + 过去分词。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 公交车刚开走，就下起雪来了。
exercises.explanation: No sooner … than 结构要倒装：No sooner had + 主语 + 过去分词 than…。
